conventions: Inflationary and vacuum quantities retain their temporal roles
excludes: Equivalence of vacuum tuning and modulus stabilization

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Evolve normalized first-order amplitudes from an early positive-energy eigenvector, then project onto the late negative-energy state. The paper uses the non-diagonal basis during evolution and its χB component for sufficiently late extraction.

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Numerically evolve non-diagonal mode equations from Bunch–Davies initial conditions and extract late-time negative-frequency amplitudes. Analytic nonadiabaticity estimates explain the proposed high-momentum continuation.

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Eliminate constrained components before evolving modes: derive independent constraint combinations, solve for temporal and longitudinal variables, and substitute into equations for the retained spinor combinations.

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Differentiate an instantaneous dispersion relation and examine where |ω'/ω²| becomes large. Use the result to locate candidate production intervals, then distinguish this diagnostic from a calculated transition probability.

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Resolve time-dependent evolution into instantaneous energy eigenstates, retain the derivative of the changing basis, and interpret the asymptotic negative-frequency component as particle production.

Inflationary parameter curves are compared with the resulting bounds.
